 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Find the solid horizontal marker and the colored object above it.
    marker = next(r for r, row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 5)
    obj_rows = [r for r in range(marker) if any(v not in (5, 2) for v in g[r])]
    color = next(g[r][c] for r in obj_rows for c in range(len(g[r])) if g[r][c] not in (5, 2))
    top = min(obj_rows)
    g[top] = [8] * len(g[top])
    for r in range(marker - 1, top - 1, -1):
        g[r + 1] = g[r][:]
    return g
"
}

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # A full-width 2 line is the divider; move the non-background object
    # toward it until adjacent, then mark the row just beyond the object.
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(g) if all(v == 2 for v in row))
    bg = next(v for row in g for v in row if v not in (2,))
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (bg, 2, 8)]
    color = g[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, c in cells if g[r][c] == color]
    minr, maxr = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
    if maxr < divider:
        delta = divider - 1 - maxr
        moved = [(r+delta,c) for r,c in cells]
        mark = minr + delta - 1
    else:
        delta = divider + 1 - minr
        moved = [(r+delta,c) for r,c in cells]
        mark = maxr + delta + 1
    # Clear old object, translate, and paint full-width marker row.
    for r,c in cells: g[r][c] = bg
    for r,c in moved: g[r][c] = color
    if 0 <= mark < h: g[mark] = [8] * w
    return g
"
